payout_quote: Official preply.com/teach: 'Choose your hourly rate and change it anytime. On average, English tutors charge $15-25 per hour.' And: 'Yes. It is free to create a tutor profile, get exposure to students, and use Preply's tools and materials. We only charge a commission for the lessons that you have taught. The commission for a trial lesson with a new student is 100%. The commission for the subsequent lessons starts at 33% and decreases to 18%.'
steps: Sign up and create your tutor profile (photo, bio, video intro, availability).
Choose your hourly rate; submit for review (approved within ~3 business days).
Teach trial lessons (100% commission to Preply) and regular lessons via Preply classroom.
Get paid via PayPal/Payoneer/Skrill/Wise; commission drops from 33% toward 18% as you teach more hours.
catches: Preply takes 100% commission on each new student's trial lesson, then 33% decreasing to 18% on subsequent lessons — you keep 67%-82%.
The $15-$25/hr is what tutors charge on average, not take-home; your net is lower after commission.
No certification required, but profile approval is selective (photo/video/description quality).
Variable demand; earnings depend on your rate, lesson volume, and student retention.
biggest_catch: The commission is steep: Preply takes 100% of trial lessons and 33% (down to 18%) of regular lessons, so your take-home is well below your posted rate until you build hours.
eligibility: No certification required; laptop/webcam/mic; profile approved within ~3 business days.
timing: Profile review ~3 business days; earnings are released after each lesson and can be withdrawn whenever desired, via PayPal/Payoneer/Skrill/Wise.
